notes.title: “Fragment：A Story in Growing” Full Voice Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
What's New:
[Fully Voiced Chinese Dialogue]
Even after the game's launch, our team never stopped creating. Through the extraordinary efforts of our voice acting team, we're proud to deliver a fully voiced experience. A heartfelt thank you to every player who supported us – simply update your game now to enjoy the captivating performances. We believe this upgrade will immerse you deeper into Wei Ran's unfolding story.

The Bee Kingdom has reclaimed its lost voices. Within the pages of this tale, Wei Ran awaits your company – to revisit half-forgotten faces, relive bittersweet moments, and grow alongside her once more.

[Reduced Star Requirements for New Chapters]
We've lowered the Star threshold needed to unlock main story chapters, letting you progress through the narrative faster than ever.

[Text Error Fixes]

Since Fragment：A Story in Growing launched, your invaluable feedback has shaped our journey. As a fledgling team, we’re profoundly grateful for your trust in our growing pains.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Bug fixed

Fixed a bug that may cause characters' name will appear in the wrong position on dialogue
Fixed a bug that may cause invisible avatars on dialogue
Fixed a bug that may cause "Ice Cream" can not combine with "Silver Spoon" at "Quality" event,
Fixed a bug that may cause entires will be deleted in accident and game stuck at "Flu" event
Fixed a bug that may cause not all "Flowers" in Chapter 3 could be collected
Fixed a bug that causes some entries names can not display in full
Fixed some texts on entries' description
Fixed some display bugs on texts in English version
Fixed some display bugs on tutorial in English version
Fixed some display bugs on collection view in Traditional Chinese version
Fixed a problem that may cause some achievements can not unlock
Fixed some display bugs after switching resolution
Fixed a bug on Album that may cause game freeze & unable to turn page

New features:
1. The default language is now consistent with the Steam interface language.
2. Added a new setting saving function, and the settings in the menu can be saved manually.


Welcome to join our Discord! (On Visual Novel Channel)
